title: Proper closed carriers and scheme-theoretic support on algebraic spaces
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and work with algebraic spaces over $S$ [def-trf-algebraic-space], in the universes of [def-weil-size-convention]. Closed immersions are representable and become closed immersions of schemes on every scheme test [def-weil-closed-immersion]. Modules are on the small etale ringed sites, with quasi-coherence [def-trf-space-quasi-coherent-module] and tensor pullback and direct image [def-trf-space-etale-module-functors]. Let $f:X\to Y$ be locally of finite type on etale scheme charts and let $M$ be a finite type quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_X$-module; finite type means etale locally finitely generated. Proper and locally of finite type are as in [def-sfb-space-morphism-properties]. The annihilator ideal $\operatorname{Ann}(M)\subseteq\mathcal O_X$ consists of local functions acting as zero on every local section of $M$. It is quasi-coherent and defines a closed subspace $Z_M\hookrightarrow X$, the scheme-theoretic support. The following are equivalent: $Z_M\to Y$ is proper; there exist a closed immersion $j:W\hookrightarrow X$ with $W\to Y$ proper and a finite type quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_W$-module $G$ with $j_*G\simeq M$. In particular, for every closed immersion $i:Z\hookrightarrow X$, the scheme-theoretic support of $i_*\mathcal O_Z$ is $Z$, and $i_*\mathcal O_Z$ admits such a proper closed carrier if and only if $Z\to Y$ is proper. No Noetherian or flatness hypothesis is imposed.

source.place: Tag 0CZI, lemma-module-support-proper-over-base, (2) iff (3); scheme-theoretic support in spaces-morphisms.tex Tags 07U1 (definition-scheme-theoretic-support) and 07U0 (lemma-scheme-theoretic-support). The structure quotient case uses its annihilator ideal.

proof.text: For an etale scheme chart U→X, pass from M|U to its Zariski quasi-coherent module using lem-trf-scheme-zariski-etale-quasi-coherent-equivalence. It is finite type by lem-sfb-space-qcoh-affine-chart-calculus. By lem-weil-pbc-scheme-theoretic-support its annihilator A_U is quasi-coherent, with affine sections Ann_R(N), where U contains Spec R and N is the section module of M. For a morphism between affine etale charts, the ring map R→B is flat by def-weil-etale-morphism. The restricted section module is B⊗_R N by the chart calculus, so lem-trf-annihilator-finite-flat-base-change identifies its annihilator with A_U B. These comparisons are equalities of ideals inside the restricted structure sheaf; hence their identities and cocycle conditions hold. Apply lem-sfb-space-qcoh-cartesian-chart-family, with the scheme etale comparison, to obtain a quasi-coherent ideal A⊆O_X. On every chart, a belongs to A exactly when it kills all restricted local sections of M (the scheme annihilator criterion and the same flat-base-change equality on further etale charts). Thus A is the annihilator defined in the statement, and AM=0.

source.place: Tag 07U0, lemma-scheme-theoretic-support, chart construction; algebra.tex Tag 07T8; spaces-properties.tex Tag 03LZ

proof.text: By lem-sfb-space-ideal-closed-subspace-correspondence, A cuts out a closed subspace i:Z_M→X. Since AM=0, lem-sfb-space-closed-immersion-quasi-coherent-modules supplies G∈QCoh(Z_M) and i_*G≅M. If j:W→X is any closed carrier for M, its ideal J annihilates j_*G' by the same essential-image assertion, so J⊆Ann(M)=A. The inclusion-reversing correspondence therefore gives a closed inclusion Z_M⊆W over X. Thus Z_M is the smallest closed carrier, which is precisely the scheme-theoretic support of Tag 07U1.

source.place: Tags 07U0 and 07U1, lemma-scheme-theoretic-support and definition-scheme-theoretic-support; Tags 03MB and 04CJ

proof.text: The module G is finite type. Indeed choose an etale affine chart U→X and put Z_U=Z_M×_XU. By lem-trf-space-etale-module-pushforward-restriction, (i_U)_*(G|Z_U)≅M|U. By lem-sfb-space-closed-subspace-proper the closed immersion i_U is proper, hence quasi-compact and separated, so lem-trf-scheme-zariski-etale-quasi-coherent-equivalence identifies this with the scheme module direct image. The ideal A_U kills M|U. By lem-weil-pbc-closed-immersion-pushforward-annihilated its scheme tensor pullback H=i_U^*(M|U) is finite type and (i_U)_*H≅M|U. Fully faithfulness in lem-sfb-space-closed-immersion-quasi-coherent-modules identifies G|Z_U with H. These Z_U form an etale scheme cover of Z_M, so finite type follows from lem-sfb-space-qcoh-affine-chart-calculus. Consequently, if Z_M→Y is proper, i and this G are the required proper closed carrier.

Conversely suppose j:W→X is a proper closed carrier with j_*G'≅M. Step 2 gives a closed immersion k:Z_M→W and j k=i, from the actual ideal inclusion J⊆A; mere containment of point sets is not used. The map k is proper by lem-sfb-space-closed-subspace-proper. Since W→Y is proper by hypothesis, lem-sfb-space-proper-composition makes Z_M→W→Y proper. To use its absolute-base formulation, forget the S-structures and regard these same spaces as algebraic spaces over Spec Z; the small etale sites, diagonals, scheme charts, and tests for universal closedness are unchanged. This proves the converse, without any Noetherian or flatness assumption.

source.place: Tag 0CZI, lemma-module-support-proper-over-base, (3)⇒(2), via the smallest closed carrier; spaces-morphisms.tex Tags 04XZ and 04XY

proof.text: For a closed immersion i:Z→X with ideal I, lem-sfb-space-closed-ideal-correspondence gives i_*O_Z≅O_X/I. It is quasi-coherent, and on each affine etale chart its section module is R/I, generated by 1, by lem-sfb-space-qcoh-affine-chart-calculus. Hence it is finite type. A local function a annihilates O_X/I if and only if a·1=0 in that quotient, equivalently a∈I; the converse holds on all further restrictions. Thus Ann(i_*O_Z)=I, and the closed-ideal bijection identifies its scheme-theoretic support with Z. Apply the equivalence proved in steps 3–4 to obtain the final properness assertion.

lean.statement: theorem module_proper_carrier_support {S : Scheme.{u}} {X Y : AlgebraicSpace S} (f : X ⟶ Y) (hf : MapIsLocally (@LocallyOfFiniteType) f) (M : X.Modules) (hMq : M.IsQuasicoherent) (hMt : M.IsFiniteType) : ∃ (A : QuasiCoherentIdeal X) (C : ClosedSubspace X), (∀ (U : X.EtaleSite) (a : X.structureSheaf.obj.obj (op U)), a ∈ Set.range (A.val.arrow.val.app (op U)) ↔ ∀ (V : X.EtaleSite) (r : V ⟶ U) (s : M.val.obj (op V)), X.structureSheaf.obj.map r.op a • s = 0) ∧ A.val = kernelSubobject (moduleStructureMap C.val.arrow) ∧ (MapIsProper (C.val.arrow ≫ f) ↔ ∃ (W : AlgebraicSpace S) (j : W ⟶ X) (G : W.Modules), IsRepresentableWith (fun _ _ p ↦ IsClosedImmersion p.left) j.hom.hom ∧ MapIsProper (j ≫ f) ∧ G.IsQuasicoherent ∧ G.IsFiniteType ∧ Nonempty ((moduleDirectImage j).obj G ≅ M))
